problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 5 cargo shipments through 5 different customs checkpoints.

Each shipment must pass through checkpoints in a specific order, with each checkpoint requiring a fixed processing duration. The sequence of checkpoints and their respective processing times are defined as (Checkpoint, Duration) pairs, where the order of pairs indicates the mandatory processing sequence.

Shipment details:
* S1 follows the route: (C5, 8) → (C4, 7) → (C1, 4) → (C2, 8) → (C3, 8)
* S2 follows the route: (C5, 5) → (C3, 3) → (C2, 8) → (C1, 1) → (C4, 10)
* S3 follows the route: (C2, 1) → (C1, 9) → (C5, 2) → (C3, 2) → (C4, 7)
* S4 follows the route: (C1, 5) → (C3, 5) → (C5, 4) → (C4, 3) → (C2, 10)
* S5 follows the route: (C3, 6) → (C2, 7) → (C1, 3) → (C4, 6) → (C5, 7)

Once a shipment begins processing at a checkpoint, it must continue uninterrupted until completion. Each checkpoint can only process one shipment at a time. The objective is to determine the processing sequence for all shipments at the checkpoints to minimize the total completion time for all shipments.
